info.description: REST API for the Terraform State Manager backend.
info.title: Terraform State Manager API

get.description: Get a paginated, filterable list of audit log entries. Requires audit:read scope.

parameters.description: Filter by actor user ID (exact match)
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Filter entries at or after this RFC3339 timestamp
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Filter entries at or before this RFC3339 timestamp
parameters.name: end_date

get.description: Retrieve a single audit log entry by ID. Requires audit:read scope.
Returns the currently active OIDC configuration including group mapping settings. Client secret is never returned. Requires admin scope.

put.description: Updates the group claim name, group-to-role mappings, and default role for the active OIDC configuration. Takes effect on the next login. Requires admin scope.

get.description: Returns all role templates including system and custom templates.

post.description: Creates a new custom role template. System roles cannot be created through this endpoint.

get.description: Returns a single role template by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing role template. System role templates cannot be modified.

delete.description: Deletes a role template by ID. System role templates cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns aggregate counts for users, organizations, API keys, and audit events.

put.description: Writes the white-label theme used by the frontend. Accepts the same shape returned by GET /api/v1/ui/theme. Two routes share this handler: PUT /api/v1/admin/ui-theme (Bearer auth, requires the admin scope) for post-setup edits, and PUT /api/v1/setup/ui-theme (Authorization: SetupToken <token>) for the setup wizard's branding step before any admin user exists. Validation: color fields must match #RGB or #RRGGBB; URL fields must be absolute https:// URLs or relative paths beginning with /.

post.description: Anonymize a user's PII and revoke all access (GDPR Article 17 — right to erasure). Audit log entries are preserved with the anonymized user ID for compliance. Requires admin scope.

get.description: Export all personal data associated with a user as JSON. Implements GDPR Article 15 (right of access) and Article 20 (data portability). Requires admin scope.
Returns a paginated list of alerts for the organization
Returns a paginated list of alert rules for the organization

post.description: Creates a new alert rule for the organization

get.description: Returns a single alert rule by ID

put.description: Applies partial updates to an alert rule

delete.description: Deletes an alert rule by ID

put.description: Marks an alert as acknowledged by the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new analysis run and starts it asynchronously; returns the run ID immediately

get.description: Returns a paginated list of analysis runs for the organization
Returns the run details including summary counts

delete.description: Removes a completed, failed, or cancelled analysis run and its results

post.description: Sets the run status to cancelled and cancels its in-flight context

get.description: Returns paginated workspace results for a specific analysis run
Returns aggregated summary from the latest completed analysis run
List API keys with optional filtering by organization. Users with api_keys:manage scope can view all keys in an organization, otherwise only their own keys are visible.

post.description: Create a new API key with specified scopes. The full API key is only returned once during creation.

get.description: Retrieve a specific API key by ID. Users can only access their own keys unless they have admin scope.

put.description: Update an API key's name, scopes, or expiration. Users can only update their own keys unless they have admin scope.

delete.description: Delete a specific API key by ID. Users can only delete their own keys unless they have admin scope.

post.description: Rotate an API key by creating a new key and optionally scheduling the old key's expiration. Users can only rotate their own keys unless they have admin scope.

get.description: Returns the authentication providers available for login (e.g. OIDC). Public; consumed by the login page to render the provider picker.
Returns a paginated list of state backups for the organization

post.description: Creates a new state backup for the specified source and workspace
Creates backups for all workspaces associated with the given source

get.description: Returns all retention policies for the organization

post.description: Creates a new retention policy for the organization
Manually triggers retention policy enforcement for the organization

get.description: Returns a single retention policy by ID

put.description: Applies partial updates to a retention policy

delete.description: Deletes a retention policy by ID

get.description: Returns metadata for a single state backup

delete.description: Deletes a state backup by ID

post.description: Retrieves the stored state data for a backup
Re-computes the SHA-256 checksum and compares it to the stored value
Reads the stored backup object and verifies its SHA-256 checksum against the recorded value before restore

get.description: Returns the capabilities registered at startup, including each capability's scheduled task type (if any) and the RBAC scopes it introduces.
Returns aggregated analysis results grouped by organization.
Returns summary statistics from the latest completed analysis run.
Returns provider usage data from the latest completed run.
Returns the resource type breakdown from the latest completed run.

parameters.description: Maximum number of resource types to return (1-100, default 20)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns the Terraform version distribution from the latest completed run.
Returns historical data across multiple completed runs (last 10 by default).

parameters.description: Number of historical runs to include (1-50, default 10)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns the Terraform version pin-drift summary (required_version constraint vs in-state terraform_version) across the latest completed run. Only workspaces whose analysis run was supplied repo metadata carry a drift report.
Returns the latest snapshot per workspace combined with the last analysis status.
Returns a paginated list of drift events for the organization.

parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-100, default 20)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns a single drift event by ID.

post.description: Ingests a Terraform plan JSON from a CI pipeline as a code-drift event. Authenticated with an OIDC workload-identity bearer token verified against the configured drift-ingest issuer (not a TSM API key). Idempotent on external_ref.
post.summary: Ingest code drift from a Terraform plan

get.description: Returns a paginated list of migration jobs for the organization

post.description: Creates a new migration job and optionally starts execution
Simulates a migration and returns what would be migrated
Validates a migration configuration without creating a job

get.description: Returns the details of a single migration job

post.description: Cancels a pending or running migration job

get.description: Returns a paginated list of notification channels for the organization

post.description: Creates a new notification channel for the organization

get.description: Returns a single notification channel by ID

put.description: Applies partial updates to a notification channel

delete.description: Deletes a notification channel by ID

post.description: Sends a test notification through the specified channel

get.description: Get a paginated list of all organizations.

post.description: Create a new organization.

get.description: Search organizations by name or display name with pagination.
Retrieve a specific organization by its ID, including member list.

put.description: Update an existing organization's name, display name, and optional IdP binding. Memberships reference the organization by UUID and are unaffected by a rename. Set idp_type to "oidc", "saml", or "ldap" to restrict login; set to empty string to clear.

delete.description: Remove an organization and its associated records.

get.description: Retrieve all members of a specific organization including user details.

post.description: Add a user as a member to an organization, optionally assigning a role template.

put.description: Update a member's role template within an organization.

delete.description: Remove a user from an organization's membership.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of reports for the organization

post.description: Generates a report for a completed analysis run and stores it via the storage backend

get.description: Returns report metadata

delete.description: Deletes the report metadata and the stored file

get.description: Streams the report file to the client
Returns a paginated list of scheduled tasks for the organization.

parameters.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (1-100, default 20)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a new scheduled task for the authenticated user's organization.

get.description: Returns a single scheduled task by ID.

put.description: Applies partial updates to a scheduled task.

delete.description: Deletes a scheduled task by ID.

post.description: Manually triggers immediate execution of a scheduled task.

put.description: Writes the white-label theme used by the frontend. Accepts the same shape returned by GET /api/v1/ui/theme. Two routes share this handler: PUT /api/v1/admin/ui-theme (Bearer auth, requires the admin scope) for post-setup edits, and PUT /api/v1/setup/ui-theme (Authorization: SetupToken <token>) for the setup wizard's branding step before any admin user exists. Validation: color fields must match #RGB or #RRGGBB; URL fields must be absolute https:// URLs or relative paths beginning with /.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of snapshots for the organization.

parameters.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return (1-100, default 20)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Triggers an immediate snapshot capture using results from the most recent completed analysis run.

get.description: Compares two snapshots and returns the drift analysis.
Returns a single snapshot by ID.
Returns a paginated list of state sources for the authenticated user's organization

post.description: Creates a new state source with encrypted sensitive config fields

get.description: Returns a single state source by ID, masking sensitive config fields

put.description: Applies partial updates to a state source; sensitive config fields are encrypted before storage

delete.description: Deletes a state source by ID

post.description: Tests the connectivity of the state source by creating a backend client and running a connection test

get.description: Returns the white-label theme configuration consumed by the frontend ThemeContext to brand the application. Public — no authentication required so the login page can brand itself before sign-in. When nothing has been configured the built-in default theme is returned, so the frontend always receives a valid theme.
Get a paginated list of all users with their organization role templates. Requires users:read scope.

post.description: Create a new user. Typically users are created via OIDC; this endpoint is for admin use. Requires users:write scope.

get.description: Get the organization memberships for the currently authenticated user. No special scopes required.
Search users by email or name. Requires users:read scope.
Get a user by ID with their organization memberships. Requires users:read scope.

put.description: Update a user's name or email. Requires users:write scope.

delete.description: Delete a user by ID. Cascading deletes will handle related records. Requires users:write scope.

get.description: Get the organization memberships for a specific user. Requires users:read scope.

grace_period_hours.description: GracePeriodHours is how long the old key remains valid (0 = immediate revocation).

role_template_id.description: UUID of role template, or null to clear

idp_name.description: IdP name within type, or null to clear

source_config.description: SourceConfig holds the source backend connection details. Keys depend on source_backend: local {base_path}; s3 {bucket, region, access_key_id, secret_access_key, endpoint, prefix, force_path_style}; azure {account_name, account_key, container_name, prefix, endpoint}; gcs {bucket, project_id, credentials_json, credentials_file, endpoint}.

target_config.description: TargetConfig holds the target backend connection details. Same shape as source_config, keyed by target_backend.

OIDCIngestAuth.description: OIDC workload-identity bearer token for the code-drift ingest endpoint. Format: "Bearer {oidc-token}"
OIDCIngestAuth.name: Authorization
